GUILDBORNE_FREE_ASSET_KIT_2026-10-12.jso.title: Guildborne comprehensive free asset raw-material kit
notes: 30 Store listing records reused from two same-day prior reports without re-browsing each; 12 new listings inspected live.
18 new author-site packs have free routes and CC0 stated on primary author pages; content counts/formats are author claims, not file inventory.
Four prior Cinderlore packs use a bespoke restricted Roblox-only license, not CC0.
Do not sum model/file counts as unique assets; packs may overlap, include variations/growth stages or mixed formats.
Free acquisition does not prove all dependencies/workflows free or runtime-ready. Exact platform quotas/fees at future import remain subject to current requirements.
Runtime IDs, pinned versions and asset intake hashes remain null. No acquisition/download/import/upload/execution/publishing/spending or runtime changes.
Research candidate keys are not replacements for canonical registry logical IDs; registry unchanged.
